insights.name: PROD-556 v3 · 주간 사용자 Funnel (동일 Hashtag · 30분)
insights.description: 최초 첫 페이지 result_count 기준 사용자 Funnel/Empty. 30분 ordered·동일 hashtag_id. 결과 0은 Empty, >0은 목록 도달. 반복 사용자는 distinct 합집합. 이전 화면 진입·요청 품질 지표 폐기, 수치 연속성 없음. production 인수 pending.

source.query:
WITH funnel_events AS (
SELECT person_id AS account_id, properties['hashtag_id'] AS hashtag_id, timestamp, event, toInt(properties['result_count']) AS result_count
  FROM events
  WHERE {filters}
    AND timestamp >= toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY, 'Asia/Seoul'), 1)
    AND timestamp <= now()
    AND event IN ('profile_hashtag_clicked', 'profile_hashtag_list_viewed', 'profile_hashtag_profile_selected')
    AND properties['$user_id'] != '' AND properties['hashtag_id'] != ''
    AND properties['$host'] = 'kos.moe' AND properties['$lib'] = 'web'
    AND coalesce(properties['$virt_is_bot'], false) = false
    AND coalesce(nullIf(properties['$virt_traffic_type'], ''), 'Regular') = 'Regular'
),
start_weeks AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT account_id, hashtag_id,
    toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul'), 1) AS week
  FROM funnel_events WHERE event = 'profile_hashtag_clicked'
), per_tag_user AS (
  SELECT starts.week, starts.account_id, starts.hashtag_id,
    windowFunnel(1800)(
      toDateTime(observed.timestamp),
      observed.event = 'profile_hashtag_clicked' AND observed.timestamp < starts.week + INTERVAL 7 DAY,
      observed.event = 'profile_hashtag_list_viewed' AND observed.result_count > 0,
      observed.event = 'profile_hashtag_profile_selected'
    ) AS steps
  FROM start_weeks AS starts
  INNER JOIN funnel_events AS observed
    ON observed.account_id = starts.account_id AND observed.hashtag_id = starts.hashtag_id
  WHERE observed.timestamp >= starts.week
    AND observed.timestamp < starts.week + INTERVAL 7 DAY + INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
  GROUP BY starts.week, starts.account_id, starts.hashtag_id
), per_user AS (
  SELECT week, account_id, max(steps) AS steps FROM per_tag_user GROUP BY week, account_id
)
SELECT week, countIf(steps >= 1) AS clicked_users,
  countIf(steps >= 2) AS list_users, countIf(steps >= 3) AS selected_users,
  list_users / nullIf(clicked_users, 0) AS list_reach_rate,
  selected_users / nullIf(clicked_users, 0) AS user_conversion_rate,
  selected_users / nullIf(list_users, 0) AS list_to_selection_rate,
  'prod-556-user-funnel-v3' AS calculation_rule_version, now() AS calculated_at
FROM per_user GROUP BY week ORDER BY week

source.query:
SELECT toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Seoul'), 1) AS week,
  count() AS result_views,
  countIf(toInt(properties['result_count']) = 0) AS empty_views,
  empty_views / nullIf(result_views, 0) AS empty_rate,
  'prod-556-user-funnel-v3' AS calculation_rule_version, now() AS calculated_at
FROM events
WHERE {filters}
  AND timestamp >= toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(now() - INTERVAL 90 DAY, 'Asia/Seoul'), 1)
  AND timestamp <= now()
  AND event = 'profile_hashtag_list_viewed'
  AND toInt(properties['result_count']) BETWEEN 0 AND 20
  AND properties['$user_id'] != '' AND properties['hashtag_id'] != ''
  AND properties['$host'] = 'kos.moe' AND properties['$lib'] = 'web'
  AND coalesce(properties['$virt_is_bot'], false) = false
  AND coalesce(nullIf(properties['$virt_traffic_type'], ''), 'Regular') = 'Regular'
GROUP BY week ORDER BY week
